sha256:53ed87fadf8cca869da921627e6a13c84.summary: Isometric CAD rendering of a U-shaped rectangular block with a front-facing open slot. Two parallel outer walls each show three vertically aligned circular holes; the exposed inner back wall of the slot also shows three vertically aligned circular holes. Nine visible circular openings in total. No holes are visible on the top or right-side surfaces.

visible_evidence.description: Overall U-shaped solid: a rectangular prism with a rectangular notch/slot cut into the front face, producing two vertical walls and an inner back wall.
Front-facing rectangular open slot between the left and right walls, exposing a salmon/pink-colored inner back wall.
Left outer vertical wall with three circular holes arranged vertically: top cyan, middle dark blue, bottom cyan.
Right outer vertical wall with three circular holes arranged vertically: top cyan, middle dark blue, bottom cyan.
Inner back wall of the slot with three circular holes arranged vertically: top magenta, middle dark blue, bottom magenta.
Top planar surface of the block; no holes or openings visible.
Right-side planar surface of the block; no holes or openings visible.

uncertain.description: Whether the visible circular openings are through-holes, blind holes, or pockets; depth and back-side geometry are not visible.
Possible holes, slots, or features on hidden faces (back outer wall, bottom, fully occluded side walls) cannot be confirmed.
Whether any inner-back-wall holes are coaxial with or connect to outer-wall holes is not visible.
The color variation of hole interiors (cyan, magenta, dark blue) may indicate orientation, lighting, or material and does not confirm hole type or size.
